Q5731.reason: The brother's interest is a condition-based interest that cuts short the uncle's life estate if he moves, so it is a shifting executory interest measured by the uncle's life, not a remainder.

Q5115.reason: Lactate forms when glycolytic flux outpaces pyruvate oxidation, which is most pronounced when glycolysis is switched on at the start of exercise; the other options are consequences or wrong conditions.

Q5932.reason: Catecholamine-driven hepatic glucose output during intermittent high-intensity exercise often outpaces muscle uptake, so blood glucose frequently rises; I changed from B on reconsideration, but this is weakly supported.
